headline: Decisions on AP Cybersecurity, AP Statistics, and AP Chemistry curriculum; school calendar discussion; AP and LAS outcomes reports.
summary: The committee will vote on three AP curriculum items: Cybersecurity, Statistics, and Chemistry. It will also discuss the school calendar and hear reports on LAS 25-26 and AP 2026 outcomes.
